blocks.text: Take care of your hair with the Gimme Beauty Sweet Dreams Satin Bonnet. Designed to support your unique hair texture, this ultra-soft satin bonnet supports your hair with friction, frizz, and breakage while you sleep. Made from breathable satin, this lightweight bonnet features a secure yet gentle-stretch band that stays comfortably in place through every toss and turn, so you can zzz in luxury. The adjustable band allows you to sleep well with a comfortable and secure fit. Compatible with heatless curling products, this single-layer satin helps you stay cool at night while also letting you support your blow-out or curls.

Split ends don't belong in sweet dreams. Support smoother, healthier hair while you sleep with this satin bonnet that supports your hair against rubbing or tension while tossing and turning against the pillow at night. For easy, effortless use, adjust the band to fit comfortably around your hair for an all-night hold.

At Gimme Beauty, we are a hair care brand with a mission to create a range of products that work for all hair types. Knowing hair solutions are not one size fits all. Each of you are unique, your hair care should be too. We celebrate your individual beauty and aim to elevate it with disruptive invention. Think of us as your go-to BFF for hair care. We'll give you the best advice, hype you up, and always make you feel comfortable in your own skin.

We lean into the sisterhood created by our mutual experiences with hair. Where other beauty brands might value exclusivity or eliteness, we are all about inclusion and accessibility. Our goal is to amplify hair confidence, because we believe confident women are unstoppable.

items.value: Designed for medium hair types and mid-length hair, the Sweet Dreams Satin Bonnet is made with ultra-soft satin; features an adjustable and secure stretch band that keeps it in place all night

items.label: Single-Layer Satin
items.value: The silky-smooth satin supports your hair with breakage and split ends caused by nighttime tossing and turning, while the lightweight single layer also helps you stay cool as you sleep

items.label: Anti-Static & Frizz-Free
items.value: This breathable sleep bonnet supports your hair against static cling, rubbing, or tension against the pillow throughout the night, making this the perfect addition to your night routine

items.label: Compatible with Heatless Curlers
items.value: This hair care essential is designed with enough capacity to comfortably hold hair overnight with Gimme Beauty's heatless curling products

items.label: We Take Care of Hair
items.value: Everyone should feel confident and empowered with their daily hair routine, and that's why we're here to help
